modelRouting.routingRationale: Bounded orchestration over frozen native graph/store/query/API seams.

objective: Implement canonical production NativeBlueprintOperation & factory so one-shot, resident service, CLI, MCP, & watcher refresh all execute native Blueprint without Node/process fallback.

frozenInterface.querySignature: pub fn execute_query(generation: &GraphGeneration, request: &BlueprintRequest, context: &RequestContext) -> Result<Value, BlueprintError>

queryImplementation.disposition: read-only repaired implementation; frozen signature; integration owner compiles final composition

acceptance: implement BlueprintOperation for NativeBlueprintOperation plus exact public factory; no alternate factory or duplicate query semantics
canonicalize & physically confine RequestContext repo root before every filesystem/store action; fixed .agent/graph/graph.db path
Build & Refresh build GraphGeneration then convert losslessly & publish with store::save_generation transaction; failure preserves prior generation
Status & DbStatus report typed missing/fresh/stale/corrupt state & generation without claiming freshness when unproven
manual Hub-off Build/Refresh/Status/query all work through same implementation; query operations load pinned/current generation then call only query::execute_query
request generation mismatch fails closed; context cancellation/deadline checked before, during feasible boundaries, & after build/load/save/query

watcher-injected Refresh paths/sourceClock/eventKind produce real rebuild+transactional save; subsequent query observes new generation; failed refresh preserves prior generation so service replay remains valid
Build/Refresh/Status/Search/Resolve/Recall/Expand/Impact/Path/Architecture supported; unsupported operations fail typed, never false success
no std::process/Command, Node, JavaScript runtime, subprocess, shell, network, daemon-holder requirement, or duplicate persistence/index/ranking authority

tests prove factory trait object, Hub-off build→query, refresh after code change updates persisted queried graph, failed build rollback, generation mismatch, root confinement, deadline/cancel, unsupported typed failure

integrationPolicy.requiredOwnedEdit: lib.rs adds pub mod engine; pub use engine::{native_blueprint_operation, NativeBlueprintOperation}; CLI/MCP/native service wiring uses factory
integrationPolicy.compositionGate: query.rs frozen hash required before compile/test, not before parallel engine source implementation
